policy: Audited substantial class-armor quests grant existing ordinary Ascended rewards even when repeatable. Cheap/basic hand-ins, components, returns, starter gear, spells, weapons, epics and unaudited quests retain existing behavior.

families.name: Crafted
families.reason: Named or dungeon creature trophies from Solusek's Eye, Permafrost, Najena, Mistmoore, Runnyeye and outdoor hunts, with purchased gems. This is earned class armor, not basic smithing.

families.name: Lambent
families.reason: Dungeon and named-creature armor/trophies plus prepared Lambent gems. Gem intermediates remain Normal and all final ingredients remain required.

families.name: Darkforge
families.reason: Pairs of decayed armor from Cazic-Thule with additional hunted materials or enchanted platinum. These are final armor rewards; decayed inputs remain unchanged.

families.name: Ivy Etched
families.reason: Named-creature trophies, Rune of Ivy pieces and separate adventure components, with gems or coin. Existing faction and payment requirements remain.

families.name: Totemic
families.reason: Banded armor is only one input; each final piece also requires dufrenite and two hunted ritual components from named creatures or dungeons. The basic Banded inputs do not become Ascended.

deferred: Crafted sizing exchanges remain unchanged. The existing class-match race policy makes resizing unnecessary; accepting upgraded inputs through static summon would need a separate instance-preservation audit.
Other substantial class quests require branch/input/target audit before catalog admission; eligibility is not limited to one-time quests.
Armor of Ro finishes through tradeskill recipes, requiring a separate guarded recipe audit rather than changes to its mold-grant quests.
Temple cleric armor has mixed weapon/shield branches and an older Blaize script without normal rejected-item return handling; audit that flow separately.
The separate finished cultural tradeskill armor candidate is not deployed by this change.

overthere/Kurron_Ni.pl.reason: Preserve later Shadow Knight epic progression using any Normal/Ascended combination. Original platinum>=900 gate, helper cash-return behavior, faction and once-per-spawn letter remain.
